_: mandarin-fixes.json — every hand edit made to the nine Mandarin decks, and the ONLY place one may be made. Applied by .claude/decks/mandarin-fix.js, which is idempotent and whose --check asserts the decks still carry these. The decks' generator inputs (w26-*.json) are not in this repo, so they cannot be rebuilt: this file is the whole record of how the shipped decks differ from what the generator produced. Keyed by <deck id>/<headword>. Every entry carries a `why`.

hsk30idm/略知一二.why: Written as one word where the corpus writes one space per syllable, and with no bopomofo — the one shape check-pinyin.js skips, so these were the residue its own repair could not reach. Every bopomofo syllable is the one the other 11,500 notes already use for that character in that reading; the two the corpus had no evidence for are 露 lòu and neutral 料.

hsk30l1/再.why: Shared one gloss with two or more other notes, so the English → Chinese card asked a question with several right answers and the reader had no way to tell a wrong answer from a collision.
